objective_conditions: Volcengine Ark is both a first-party platform for Doubao/Seed models and a serving platform for third-party/open models.
Model capability and platform behavior can change independently of plugin releases.
AstrBot already owns provider lifecycle, routing/fallback/retry, provider-source/model-card management, metadata display, and Dashboard rendering.
AstrBot capability icons are incomplete feedback, not a complete model-capability truth table.
Different AstrBot provider types can have materially different Dashboard layouts and user paths.
Both plugin-owned Volcengine Ark and Agent Plan providers currently register as AstrBot chat_completion providers; Agent Plan is not an agent_runner card.
End-to-end modality availability depends on the complete QQ/NapCat/AstrBot/adapter/provider/model path, not only model capability.
A real AstrBot v4.27.2 production Dashboard has been built and started with this plugin loaded; browser login and the Provider page have been reached successfully.

The first provider-card Playwright matrix encoded unstable harness assumptions including welcome overlays, display labels, fixed source IDs, and selector structure. Its failures did not by themselves implicate plugin runtime logic.
A flow diagram does not prove reachability: each arrow requires a concrete host/plugin/upstream interface or a minimal existence experiment.
expected_outcomes: Expose implemented Volcengine request transport paths without converting them into permanent model-capability claims.
Preserve current upstream feedback without persisting stale plugin feedback as truth.
Keep provider-specific UI and configuration isolated from foreign providers.
Preserve explicit user intent during migration.
Distinguish local input-transport failure from upstream/model rejection without owning AstrBot routing decisions.
Use evidence levels so code, host integration, UI observation, real API behavior, and complete user paths are not conflated.
Validate runtime behavior with real Volcengine API execution while treating fine Dashboard layout as presentation evidence rather than a brittle release gate.

active_validation_frontier.name: real_volcengine_runtime_matrix
active_validation_frontier.reason: L2/L3 contracts and L4 Dashboard reachability are established; the next missing evidence is current real upstream runtime behavior.
